incident-bot: Pager P1 - Elevated inference latency in us-east-1. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.ai/alert/9876. War room: https://meet.redwood.ai/rooms/incident-1728643000. Pager sent to @sam (oncall), @maria (eng-platform)
sam (oncall): Acked. Oncall here, joining war room now. What's current customer impact?
maria (eng-platform): Seeing spike in tail latency for /v1/generate - p95 up from ~120ms -> ~650ms. Error rate ~18% for requests hitting kv-cache misses. A subset of API keys in us-east-1 report timeouts.
leo (eng-runtime): Confirmed in traces. KV cache eviction thrash on a handful of hosts during a high-concurrency window. Likely related to the autoscaler change rolled out 2h ago that lowered batch thresholds.
dave (sre): Short-term options: route non-enterprise traffic to eu-west, or scale the dedicated pool in us-east by +2 nodes. Can someone run the runbook steps while I coordinate scaling?
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook "inference-kv-cache-degrade" suggested. Recommended immediate actions:
- increase kv_cache.size to 48GB
- enable continuous batching for model-family x-gpt-large
- apply fallback routing for non-enterprise traffic
Suggested commands:
`redwood infra scale --pool inference-us-east --delta 2`
`redwood config set inference.kv_cache.size=48gb --env prod --region us-east-1`
`redwood router set-fallback --from model-x-v3 --to model-x-v2 --match non-enterprise`
maria (eng-platform): Applying kv_cache size bump to canary now, will promote to prod if canary metrics look good. Draft status page copy below:
"We are currently investigating elevated inference latency in US-East affecting a subset of API requests. Some customers may experience increased latency or intermittent timeouts for text generation. Our engineers are actively mitigating the issue; updates every 15 minutes."
sam (oncall): Good. I'll post that to status.redwood.ai after we validate the canary change. Who's owning the postmortem?
leo (eng-runtime): I'll own RCA and timeline. Will include kernel selection and autoscaler diffs.
dave (sre): I'll own mitigation steps and runbook edits.
maria (eng-platform): Canary promoted to prod canary group -> metrics: p95 down to ~210ms, error rate down to ~6% after 2 minutes. :thumbsup:
sam (oncall): Nice, please keep an eye for regression for next 10m. Posting status update and pinging top-3 impacted customers (sales looped). War room recording -> https://meet.redwood.ai/rooms/incident-1728643000/recording
incident-bot: Incident summary: Severity=P1 | Owner=leo (eng-runtime) | Mitigation owner=dave (sre) | War room=https://meet.redwood.ai/rooms/incident-1728643000 | Next update in 15m
maria (eng-platform): leaving a note here — if kv thrash reappears we'll fallback routing immediately and scale further.
dave (sre): Monitoring dashboards, alert thresholds lowered for kv-cache evict spikes. If we see recurrence, I'll trigger fallback routing. :eyes: 
sam (oncall): Thanks all. Handing continuous watch to the night oncall at 1728646600; will keep channel open for handoff notes.
